faq.question: What makes this different from a normal podcast booking?
faq.answer: Broadcast-style recordings usually need more planning around guest count, pacing, camera direction and visual tone. It is closer to a controlled business media shoot.

faq.question: Can Birdcast record panel discussions?
faq.answer: Yes. Panel and roundtable formats can be planned depending on the number of speakers, seating needs and selected studio setup.

faq.question: Is this suitable for company announcements?
faq.answer: Yes. Companies can use this format for leadership messages, expert panels, campaign conversations or public-facing business media.

faq.question: Should we prepare questions in advance?
faq.answer: Yes. Prepared talking points or a question flow help the team understand the pacing and make the recording more focused.

faq.question: Why is WhatsApp recommended first?
faq.answer: Broadcast-style projects often have custom requirements, so it is better to confirm speakers, format and setup before choosing a booking slot.
